verdict.rationale: First-party mobile docs say official Grok Bot apps run on iPhone and Android, letting users start work, answer questions, approve steps, and review results away from the desk. Threads continue across phone and desktop, iOS supports the share sheet, and a runtime probe confirms iOS and Android are official app surfaces. One hands-on report says GitHub login on iOS was broken, which is a reliability issue rather than evidence the apps don't exist. Missing for 10: evidence of feature parity with the desktop apps (e.g., Agent Computer view, skills and routine management on mobile), Android-specific capabilities such as share integration, and independent hands-on corroboration that the mobile apps work well.
